name: Factor Restriction on a Minimal Non-Maximum-Generated Class
statement: If an ample class outside $\mathsf{MaxMin}$ has the least possible number of coordinates, it cannot have the form $(B\times T)\cup(S\times\{0,1\}^Y)$ with $\varnothing\ne S\subsetneq B$, nonempty proper $T$, $|X|\ge1$, and $|Y|\ge2$. The same holds for a least-coordinate member of $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ outside $\mathsf{MaxMin}$.
proof: The class is the substitution of the smaller peripheral expansion $E(B,S)$ by the smaller test $T$. Both recovered factors belong to the same ambient family and have fewer coordinates. Minimality therefore places both in $\mathsf{MaxMin}$, and the nested-section substitution theorem constructs a maximum parent of the original class, a contradiction.
comments: The conclusion uses a parent of the joint expansion $E(B,S)$; separate parents of $B$ and $S$ do not suffice.
